facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/123340 ('Vault toilets, drinking water from a hand pump ... The nearest dump station is 27 miles away on Powder River Pass.') + FS page ('Potable water is available at this site.'), read 2026-11-20

values.note: Sites 2 and 10 are first-come; the rest book online at least four days ahead.

booking.source: recreation.gov 123340 (notice 'Reservations must be made at least 4 days in advance.'; catalog 02 and 10 'Not Reservable'; maxConsecutiveStay 14) + FS page ('This site can be reserved', '14 day stay limit'), read 2026-11-20

note: Bighorn NF campground with widely spaced sites at the edge of a meadow in lodgepole and aspen, about 15 mi west of Buffalo off the Cloud Peak Skyway (2 mi up FS Road 20); the Circle Park Trailhead into the Cloud Peak Wilderness is nearby. Run by a concessionaire. --Claude
summary: rec.gov + FS read: 10 back-in sites (30-50 ft), no hookups, vault toilets, hand-pump water, no dump; $18.50 (rec.gov 2026-27; FS says $20), 2nd vehicle $9; reservable 4+ days ahead, sites 2 and 10 FCFS, 14-night max; Memorial Day-Labor Day. All groups written; note cleaned. Concessionaire-run (Rustic Freedom).
